name: durationToExpiry
signature: export function durationToExpiry(duration: Duration, state: GameState, controllerId: PlayerId): Expiry
layerOrTiming: n/a - describes when an effect stops
contract: Returns pure JSON. A closure would not survive the jsonb column or a replay on a client that received only the action log, which is the DSL central promise.
end-of-turn expires at the cleanup step of the turn that is current WHEN THE EFFECT IS CREATED, recorded as an absolute turn number, not as a relative countdown a replay could mis-decrement.
your-next-turn records the controller and a turn number, so a skipped turn does not end it early.
while-source-on-battlefield records no turn at all: it is not time-based, and inventing a turn for it would end an anthem at cleanup.

evidence.claim: end of turn is a named duration
while on battlefield is a separate, non-time-based duration

assertions.expect: kind while-source, and no turn field at all

unlocks.source: supporting primitive for P01 and P02
